title: Forge Receipt
description: Receipt produced after Forge promotes an experiment to production module space.

target_path.description: Production path where experiment was written.

all_gates_passed.description: Must be true. Forge receipt with all_gates_passed: false is invalid.

attestation_verified.description: Whether Attestation was verified. true for all L8 self-modifications.

downstream_reverification_notified.description: Module IDs marked NEEDS_REVERIFICATION due to this promotion.

experiment_archived.description: Whether experiment was moved to archive/ before this receipt was written.

archive_path.description: Path in .wabblespec/experiments/archive/ where experiment was archived.

provenance_record.description: Path to provenance.json entry for this promotion.
